body_en: Pollution has sources you can name: smoke, plastic, dirty rivers. Learn one local problem and one fix students can support. Plant trees if your school runs a green project. Speak with facts, not only anger.
body_zh: 污染有可点名的来源：烟、塑料、脏河。了解一个本地问题与学生能支持的一个对策。学校有绿化项目就参与种树。用事实说话，不只靠愤怒。
